verdict.rationale: Better Auth's session-management docs cover configurable expiry (`expiresIn`, 7-day default) and sliding refresh via `updateAge`, with an explicit refresh flow (`needsRefresh` plus a client POST). The security reference documents session revocation across devices, and a community user confirms out-of-the-box refresh-token handling. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that revocation is immediate and server-side, an admin/server API to revoke another user's compromised session (only self-revocation by the logged-in user is documented), and independent hands-on corroboration of revocation.
